title: Design a Secure Session Repository
prompt: Specify a PKCE sign-in, session model, credential persistence boundary, account switch, expiry, redacted diagnostics, and complete logout path.
successCriteria: No static secret is bundled in the app.
Raw tokens never leave the session boundary or logs.
Logout produces one tested unauthenticated state and cache policy.
hints: Name the authoritative state and durable identity before selecting a library API.
Test the operation after cancellation, duplication, or process recreation.

starterCode.code: class SecureSessionRepository(/* private storage, clock, authorization service */)

solutionOutline: Model the data, operation, failure, and recovery states explicitly.
Implement the transactional path and prove every adverse success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic persistence or protocol tests.
Inspect durable state after interruption and retry.
